in_hebrew.name: דוי
in_hebrew.meaning: דוי הוא שמו של אחד ממשפחות הכוהנים בישראל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דוי הוא שם עברי שמקורו בשם דוד, שפירושו 'אחד ששולט באהבה' או 'חביב'. השם דוי מוזכר בשמות המשפחות של הכוהנים בישראל, ויש לו קשרים עם המלך דוד. השם נושא משמעות של כוח, אהבה וחיבור לאלוקים.

in_greek.name: Ντόυ
in_greek.meaning: Το Ντόυ είναι παραλλαγή του ονόματος Δαυίδ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ντόυ είναι ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος דוי, το οποίο σχετίζεται με το όνομα του βασιλιά Δαυίδ. Το όνομα σημαίνει 'αυτός που αγαπά' ή 'αυτός που είναι αγαπητός'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Δαυίδ αναφέρεται συχνά ως πρόγονος του Ιησού Χριστού.

in_latin.name: Doy
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Doy derivatur ex hebraeo nomine דוי, quod significat 'amore potens' vel 'dilectus'. Nomen David in Biblia latina est commune, et Doy est forma christiana, quae primo in familia sacerdotali Israëlis apparuit.

in_english.name: Doy
in_english.meaning: Beloved or one who rules with love
in_english.long_meaning: The name Doy originates from the Hebrew name דוי, related to King David. It signifies 'one who rules with love' or 'beloved'. Historically, the name Doy has been associated with the priestly families of Israel. It carries connotations of leadership, love, and devotion to God. While not directly mentioned in the Bible, its root in David provides a rich biblical heritage.

data.cultural_impact: The name Doy, derived from Greek, signifies the idea of a divine gift of a child from God. In many Christian communities, the names of children are very significant, and this name holds a special place. Naming a child Doy cements the belief that every child is a blessing from God and a gift to be cherished and nurtured. Moreover, it is a reminder of the divine power of creation and God's love and care for His children.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Doy signifies the deep faith and reverence of Christians towards God. The name holds the belief that each life is precious and sacred, bestowed upon us by the Creator. It is a reminder of our spiritual connection to God and our duty to live a life worthy of this divine gift. Additionally, the name Doy represents the humility and gratitude of parents who recognize the ultimate giver of their child and express their faith through naming their child accordingly.
